name_reason: Compliant data_fd2_<domain=ui>_<descriptor> name. '_field_command_menu' identifies the consumer/menu, '_options' identifies it as the option-id list, and '_template' reflects that it is a const source array copied per menu-open into a local stack buffer (matching the sibling family data_fd2_ui_game_options_menu_slots_template, data_fd2_ui_inline_action_menu_template, etc.). No Ghidra address residue; numbers 7/5/6/4 are option text-token ids (domain values), not address tails. Datatype is reflected via the _template/_options descriptor for this UI option list.
purpose: Const source template holding the 4 option text-token ids for the in-field command menu (Save/Load, End Turn, Options, Suspend); copied per menu-open into a local stack buffer fed to the settings-dialog renderer.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_field_command_menu_loop (@0x16F71) copies all 4 int32 words via REP MOVSD (MOV ECX,4; MOV ESI,0x51E9F; REP MOVSD -> dword stride 4) into a local menu_options[16] stack buffer, then passes that buffer to fd2_open_settings_dialog_with_slide / fd2_settings_menu_input_step to render and drive the modal. Paired with data_fd2_ui_field_command_menu_state_template @0x53EF2 (per-option enable/disable flags, also copied to the stack and mutated locally). The global source array is only ever read.
element_semantics: Each element is a 32-bit option text-token id selecting the menu row label: [0]=7 Save/Load(/New Game), [1]=5 End Turn, [2]=6 Options, [3]=4 Suspend. Stored values {7,5,6,4} verified from memory; access is a full-dword copy (stride 4), so the element width is int32.
